structured_output.summary: The diff implements Date.prototype.setFullYear in its own file, following the spec steps 1-11 in order. The TypeError for a non-object or non-Date `this` is thrown before any observable work. tv is read before ToNumber(year). NaN tv becomes +0, otherwise LocalTime. Month and day use ToNumber only when the argument is present (args.len() > 1 / > 2), so explicit undefined is handled correctly. MakeDate, MakeDay, TimeWithinDay, UTC and TimeClip are called in spec order, the result is stored with set_time_value, and u is returned. No special-casing, hardcoded values or swallowed errors appear. The gate shows 28 new passes and no regressions. The 4 remaining failures come from the tests calling the unimplemented setTime, not from this file.

They must already exist in support::date, which the passing build implies, but their correctness was not reviewed here.
